title: The Plumbing Principle
equation: Scalable Revenue = Lead Flow × System Integrity × Customer Experience
hook: More leads won't save a messy business. They'll just make the mess louder.
statement: Fix your systems before you push more leads through them, because broken operations turn traffic into waste.
explainer: Unclear sales means more confusion. Messy delivery means more stress. Weak onboarding means more refunds. Before you spend on ads or PR, make sure the business can handle who shows up.
sop: Map the full customer journey, start to finish.
Find leaks in response time, sales, onboarding, delivery, and retention.
Fix the most expensive leak first.
Test with a small bump in traffic.
Scale only once the system handles volume smoothly.
equation_example: Lead Flow 8, System Integrity 4, Customer Experience 6. 8 × 4 × 6 = 192 Scalable Revenue, out of 1,000. Higher means you can take on more leads profitably. Lower means more leads will just expose the bottlenecks already there.
question: Write down the one spot where doubling your leads tomorrow would cause the biggest headache.
closing_statement: Growth doesn't fix problems. It multiplies them.
caption:
Principle Nº 246: The Plumbing Principle

More leads won't save a messy business. They'll just make the mess louder.

Fix your systems before you push more leads through them, because broken operations turn traffic into waste.
